item.title: Week of October 5th, 2026. $MPC $MTRN $TWLO $NVDA $CHEF
item.description: 5 stocks for your watchlist: MPC, MTRN, TWLO, NVDA, CHEF. Not financial advice.
item.content:encoded:
Week of October 5th, 2026. $MPC $MTRN $TWLO $NVDA $CHEF

The (Stock) Watchlist is back for the first time since summer 2020: three momentum leaders, one social-buzz name and one under-the-radar sleeper for the week of Oct 5. Data as of the Fri Oct 2 close (MPC prices as of the Thu Oct 1 close).

Market pulse

  • September payrolls rose just 29K, cutting October Fed hike odds from about 64% to about 20%. The Nasdaq 100 closed at a record, but the S&P 500 (-0.3%) and Dow (-1.3%) fell on the week as the 10-year yield closed at 5.28% after hitting its highest levels since 2002 this week.
  • Breadth is narrow: only about a quarter of S&P 500 stocks are above their 50-day. Brent is still above $100 on the Iran war. Takeaway: be picky, leadership is narrow.
  • Week ahead: FOMC minutes and a $39B 10-year note auction (Wed Oct 7), PepsiCo (Thu), Delta (Fri). Weekend: Yemen's Houthis claimed an attack on an Aramco facility in Riyadh; damage unconfirmed.

The picks

  • $MPC: Momentum leader. Refiner that logged six straight weekly gains in September on a record diesel crack, then jumped about 6% Thursday to about $420 on fuel-shortage headlines, a couple percent under its all-time high (reportedly about $431). Friday's G7 diesel reserve release is the twist. Levels: breakout on a close above about $431, support $400, setup breaks below $380.
  • $MTRN: Momentum leader. Beryllium and advanced-materials maker with a record Q2 and two guidance raises this year; closed about $312 Friday after an intraday all-time high near $314. No company news found to explain Friday's pop. Stretched (roughly 25% above its 50-day) and rich (about 45x guided earnings). Levels: trigger on a close above $314, support $290, breaks below $285.
  • $TWLO: Momentum leader. Joins the S&P 500 before Tuesday's open; index buying normally lands in Monday's closing auction. Closed about $301, just under its $306 52-week high (not an all-time high). Roughly 30% above its 50-day, so this one is about the reaction, not a chase. Levels: close above $306 once it's in the index, support $290, breaks below $280.
  • $NVDA: Social buzz. First record since May (about $238 intraday, closed about $234), a fresh breakout attempt only about 7% above a rising 50-day. Record $150B buyback addition; Morgan Stanley restored it as its top chip pick. Retail returning, not stampeding: Stocktwits called chatter normal and sentiment neutral. Levels: confirmation on a close above about $238, support and line in the sand at the rising 50-day near $218, 200-day near $207 below that.
  • $CHEF: Under-the-radar sleeper. About $4.8B specialty food distributor to fine-dining restaurants and hotels; new all-time high Friday out of a month-long range, only about 7% above a rising 50-day. Not cheap at about 47x earnings, and Q3 results are not yet scheduled. Levels: trigger on a close above about $118.50 on rising volume, support near $110, breaks below $105.

Scorecard: None yet. Starting next week, every pick is logged and graded against the S&P 500.

*I'm not a financial advisor, this isn't financial advice, always do your own DD before putting money into any stock.* Follow me on Twitter [@scottiewick](https://twitter.com/scottiewick).
